title: eat, shit & die 275
author: bpatrick
html:
I feel like I should mention that alcohol withdrawal can be very dangerous and is one of the only substances the withdrawal from which can be fatal. If you are having any signs of delirium tremens like shaking, hallucinations, feeling like you might pass out or seizure you should go to the ER. If you experience shaking in the morning or need a drink in the morning to feel ok you and are thinking of quitting alcohol you should probably do a medical detox to be safe.

I’ve played Trent’s alcoholism for laughs but for everyone suffering from addiction, I feel you and hope for the best for you. You’re stronger than you think.
